# PokeByte <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Banks](BlitzBasic-Banks)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PokeByte:Void bank:Int32, offset:Int32, value:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bank` | In | Int32 | required | The bank to write to. |
| `offset` | In | Int32 | required | Position in bytes. |
| `value` | In | Int32 | required | The value to store. |

## Description

Writes one byte. Values outside 0 to 255 wrap around, so 300 is stored as 44 and -1 as 255.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
bank = CreateBank(2)
PokeByte bank, 0, 300
PokeByte bank, 1, -1
Print PeekByte(bank, 0)
Print PeekByte(bank, 1)
FreeBank bank
```

```text
44
255
```
